    Assistant Manager, Vehicle Engineering

    Taught a model to crash cars, so the supercomputer didn't have to

    Every pedestrian-safety simulation burned hundreds of compute hours. I built an ML model that predicts the injury score from design inputs, so engineers only simulate the designs worth simulating.

    Lab notebook · Chakr Innovation · 2024–25

    Technical Project Manager, Moonshot R&D

    Tried to power EVs with aluminium and thin air

    Aluminium-air batteries could make EVs far cheaper, if the metal performs and stays affordable. I led the six-person R&D team solving both.

    −1.35 V
    −1.35 V · where we started−1.70 V · where we got

    Illustration, not lab data. A more negative potential meant fewer parasitic reactions and a more efficient cell.

    • 83%of peak performance from scrap aluminium, the key to commercial viability
    • −40%raw-material cost. I built the supply chain on the ground in China
    • 5× fasterand 90% cheaper testing, using an ML model I built
    • Amazon, Swiggyinterested after a month-long vehicle pilot. I ran the go-to-market myself

    Principles

    Distribution beats features.

    We chose WhatsApp over an app. Users were already there.

    Fix the funnel before the model.

    Our biggest conversion jump came from fixing scheduling, not the model.

    Evals are the spec.

    If you can't score it, you can't ship it.

    Mistakes are tuition.

    I've paid plenty. Ask me about my favourite one.
